items.resolution: During a composition (compositionstart→compositionend) no storage write and no DOM mutation of any section textarea occurs; the committed text is saved within 400 ms after compositionend; the caret position and textarea node identity are unchanged across typing and composition; a page close/pagehide right after typing still persists the last edit.

Two songs may share the same title; they remain separate songs distinguished by id; a new song takes the next unused number N in 「未命名歌曲 N」 (gaps are not refilled unless N is the next free integer above the current max).
items.probe: When two things are exactly equal or just touch, do they merge, collide, or separate?

items.resolution: With zero songs (all deleted, or corrupt/empty lh:songs) the app always shows exactly one empty song; deleting the last song creates a new empty song; a migrated v0.96 user with an empty or missing haiku_lyrics gets one song with one empty section, and a blank rename keeps the previous title.
items.probe: What is the result for empty, single-element, or null input?

items.resolution: The song list is ordered by createdAt descending (newest first); ties broken by id ascending (stable); switching or editing a song does not reorder the list.
items.probe: When elements compare equal, is output order specified and stable?

items.resolution: Running the 1→2 migration again (reload, second tab, re-run after crash) never creates a second migrated song: the fixed id song-migrated and the existing-valid-lh:songs check make it a no-op, and the legacy keys remain byte-identical.
items.probe: What happens if this runs twice on the same input?

items.resolution: If the migration is interrupted between writing lh:songs and setting lh:schema=2, the next boot converges to exactly one migrated song; two tabs editing different songs never lose each other's edits (merge-on-write re-reads lh:songs before each flush); the same song edited in two tabs is last-write-wins.
items.probe: If interrupted or run in parallel, what is guaranteed?

items.resolution: Export of a song whose sections are all blank shows a toast and produces no file; blank sections are skipped in TXT/Markdown/print output and blank labels fall back to 「段落 n」; the TXT built for download and the text copied to the clipboard are byte-identical; Markdown escapes lines starting with #, >, -, *, + or 1.; download filenames replace \ / : * ? " < > | with _.
In 「只加入歌曲」 mode an imported song whose id already exists gets a new id and a title colliding with an existing one gets the suffix 「（匯入）」; saved words are merged and de-duplicated by exact string.
items.probe: When two things are exactly equal or just touch, do they merge, collide, or separate?

items.resolution: A backup with zero songs, an empty file, invalid JSON, a wrong format, a newer version, or a file over 5 MB is rejected with a plain-language error and changes no stored data.
items.probe: What is the result for empty, single-element, or null input?

items.resolution: Imported songs keep their relative createdAt order from the backup; in add-only mode they are inserted into the list by createdAt like any other song; in replace mode the active song becomes the backup's activeSong if present, else the newest song.
